name: Vignette ID
description: Web + iOS app for buying highway e-vignettes and tunnel tolls in 9 European countries (SI, AT, CZ, SK, CH, RO, HU, BG, MD) in 21 languages: pick vehicle, plate, start date, and pay with card / Apple Pay / Google Pay. It also sends expiry reminders. Ukrainian team of 2–5, founded Jan 2022, bootstrapped (founder-stated). TrustMRR lists 2026 EIC (European Innovation Council) support.

mentions.evidence: ~$32,547 L30, ~$623,521 all-time, MRR ~$35 / 14 subs (almost everything is one-off purchases). Revenue synced Oct 6, 2026 ~07:43 Warsaw (05:43 UTC). Company-stated on homepage: 3,716,843 vignettes sold. TrustMRR "estimated users" 2,500,000 (founder-stated). Note: the Stripe totals probably include the pass-through vignette price, not just the service margin (my inference; the margin isn't disclosed).
mentions.indieAngle: "One checkout for N annoying state portals." Same shape works for parking zones (PL Strefa Płatnego Parkowania per city), low-emission-zone stickers (DE Umweltplakette, FR Crit'Air), ferry/bridge tolls, or fleet bulk-buying with invoices. SEO for "<country> vignette 2027" does the marketing every spring.

whyItPrints: Government toll-payment glue. Drivers crossing several countries otherwise deal with nine separate state portals in local languages, and get fined if they skip it. The product is a checkout over official systems. Volume comes from summer/holiday traffic and fleets.
whyThisMatters:
You're driving through Slovenia, Austria, Czechia, Slovakia, Switzerland, Romania, Hungary, Bulgaria, or Moldova. You buy the highway vignette in one checkout, in twenty-one languages. Vehicle, plate, start date, then card, Apple Pay, or Google Pay. No sticker. They say it works right away.

Use the toll road without one and you can get fined. They remind you before it runs out. There's a website and an iPhone app, and they say support is on day and night.

It's a Ukrainian team of two to five, started in January 2022, and the founder says they're bootstrapped. The listing mentions 2026 support from the European Innovation Council. They've sold 3,716,843 vignettes. There's an API if you want to sell them from your own software.
